narrative.label: Scores revenue, June quarter
narrative.note: Up from $324 million. Management tied the business-to-business increase to a higher mortgage origination score unit price. The filing does not split mortgage origination scores out of that book.

narrative.label: Scores revenue, nine months
narrative.note: Already above the full prior year. Fiscal 2025 Scores were $1.17 billion.

narrative.label: Business-to-business Scores, fiscal 2025
narrative.note: 81% of Scores that year. This is the toll the mortgage grid can contest. Fiscal 2026 split is not in the June quarterly report.

narrative.label: Direct-to-consumer Scores, fiscal 2025
narrative.note: myFICO. The mortgage grid does not set this price.

narrative.label: Software revenue, fiscal 2025
narrative.note: Grew 3%. Software operating income fell $9.8 million. That is not an offset if Scores weaken.

narrative.label: Interest expense, nine months
narrative.note: Up from $94 million. The quarterly report ties the increase to a higher average debt balance: notes issued in May 2025 and March 2026, and a term loan used to buy back stock.

policy.label: FHFA mortgage price grid
policy.display: One grid. Classic FICO and VantageScore 4.0 are both allowed.
policy.note: On September 28, 2026 the 20-point markdown on VantageScore was removed. Classic FICO is still allowed. A borrower at 780 on either model can reach the same top band.

policy.label: Loans underwritten by hand
policy.note: The grid change does not remove FICO from manual underwriting.

policy.label: FHA and FICO 10T
policy.note: A statement of intent, not revenue. 10T is not approved for delivery to Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac.

lenders.label: Rocket Mortgage
lenders.note: Rocket's figure, not ours: about $1,600 saved at closing for borrowers who saved money, after running both models on 1.4 million reports. One originator is not the industry.

lenders.label: United Wholesale Mortgage
lenders.display: About 25% of borrowers score better on VantageScore
lenders.note: They said that share might reach 40% by the end of September. That is not a statement that VantageScore is the preferred score.

missing.label: Equifax
missing.note: Read mortgage inquiries, any VantageScore disclosure, and mortgage-revenue growth the week Equifax reports. Do not infer those from Fair Isaac's filing.

missing.label: TransUnion
missing.note: Same three items, the week TransUnion reports.

missing.label: Experian
missing.note: Same three items, the week Experian reports.

missing.label: US mortgage origination volume
missing.note: Needed to separate a price cut from a smaller mortgage market. Not in the Fair Isaac filing.

gates.label: Only Classic FICO on the mortgage price grid
gates.statement: Classic FICO is the only score on the FHFA loan-level price grid.
gates.display: One grid. Classic FICO and VantageScore are both allowed.
gates.note: The watch wanted Classic FICO alone. On September 28, 2026 the 20-point markdown on VantageScore came off, and both scores sit on one price grid. Classic FICO is still allowed, and still required when a loan is underwritten by hand.

gates.label: Software revenue growth
gates.statement: Software revenue growth is high enough to offset a weaker Scores franchise. The watch line is 8% a year. That line is ours, not management's target.
gates.note: Watch line is 8% a year, set here so a low-single-digit software result cannot be read as a replacement for Scores. Fiscal 2025 operating income in Software fell $9.8 million.

gates.label: Net debt / annualized operating income
gates.statement: Net debt stays at or under 3 times operating income stretched to a year. This is operating income, not a company EBITDA figure.

gates.label: Large originators preferring VantageScore
gates.statement: Fewer than three large originators have named VantageScore as the preferred score. One name is an anecdote. Three is a pattern.
gates.fail_line: A pattern of lenders prefers the rival score
gates.note: Rocket has named VantageScore preferred. United Wholesale has not. The count fails at 3.

gates.label: Bureau share of revenue
gates.statement: Agreements with the three bureaus stay at or under 70% of quarterly revenue. They own VantageScore and distribute FICO. A rise through 70% is the steering gate. Margin has to be read with it.
gates.fail_line: Bureau share is through 70% of revenue
gates.note: 54% a year earlier and 51% for fiscal 2025. Holding means it has not crossed 70%. It is already the majority of revenue, and the same three firms own the rival score.

gates.label: Scores operating margin
gates.statement: Scores operating income stays at or above 80% of Scores revenue. Fiscal 2025 was 88%. A step down is the price-cut signal. The June quarterly report does not restate this margin.
gates.note: Last reported Scores margin. The June quarter does not restate it. Holding means it has not fallen through 80%.

gates.label: Mortgage origination score unit price
gates.statement: The mortgage origination score unit price is disclosed.
gates.note: The filing says the Scores increase was primarily a higher mortgage origination scores unit price. It does not give the price or the unit count. A blank here is not a pass.
